title: Clearing the field with Unassigned looks as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active staff member at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on.
  • Use a customer with no Sales Representative assigned.
  • Create an open, uninvoiced work order for this test for that customer, with one approved labor line, one part and one "Sales Representative" field set to that staff member.
  • Set the browser window to 1440 pixels wide with the zoom at 100%.
  • Open the design pictures "card-15-n1-unassign-list.png" (board 1.15) and "card-16-n1-cleared.png" (board 1.16) attached to this case beside the browser window at 100% (actual size). Names, numbers and dates in the pictures are sample data.
  • Open the work order in that browser window.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open the list.
  2. Click "Unassigned" and compare the card with the picture of board 1.16.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The list opens.

Step 2:

  • The field reads "Unassigned" as plain text, as in the picture.
  • There was never an x inside the field.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative)

  • S1-R7: “With nobody assigned, the field reads "Unassigned".”
  • S1-R10: “The field has no x inside it. Picking "Unassigned" from the dropdown clears it.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
